description: Sends the user's reply to one recruiter or employer email, under the user's name, from their GetMattered address (or their connected mailbox, when the thread arrived there). message_id comes from getmattered_get_inbox, which also drafts replies. Without a confirmation form in the client, nothing is sent: it returns the exact reply and a link where the user sends it. A sent reply cannot be unsent.

body.description: The exact plain-text reply the user approved, signed with their name.

message_id.description: The message_id of the email to answer, from getmattered_get_inbox. The reply goes to the newest email the employer sent in that conversation.

name: getmattered_reply_to_email

sentMessageId.description: The sent reply in the inbox. Null when nothing was sent.

setupStep.description: Present while account setup is open: the first setup step.

status.description: sent: the email went out; not_confirmed: the user declined, nothing was sent; send_in_app: nothing was sent, this client cannot ask the user, so the user sends the reply from the link in the text.

title: Reply to an Employer Email
